diagnosis.summary: Nightly run a73e9f8c for 2026-10-01 failed at ingest because upstream never delivered landing/customers/dt=2026-10-01/customers.csv. The orders, order_items and payments files for that day all arrived, match the contract and have normal volumes, so this looks like a one-off delivery glitch affecting only customers. Proposed fix: request upstream redelivery of customers for 2026-10-01, then rerun the partition.

root_cause.explanation: The customers landing file for 2026-10-01 does not exist, so the ingest step raised IngestError. The export did run that day: the other three event files are present, valid and normal-sized. Only the customers file was dropped, which makes this a one-off delivery problem, not a deliberate upstream change or a dbt issue.

evidence.claim: The run failed at ingest with 'landing file missing' for customers 2026-10-01
The customers file does not exist at the expected path
The orders, order_items and payments files for 2026-10-01 exist, match the contract and have no parse problems
The orders volume (440) is within the normal range of recent partitions (412-534)
Runbook: for a missing file, redeliver only the affected tables (add customers only if it is affected)

alternatives_considered: Transient failure, fixed by rerun_only: rejected because the file is truly absent, so a rerun would fail again
Full export failure, needing redelivery of all tables: rejected because orders, order_items and payments are present and normal
Empty or partial file: rejected because the path does not exist at all
Persistent upstream change, needing escalation to upstream_app_team: no evidence yet; escalate if the redelivery also comes back without the file

proposal.rationale: Ingest failed because landing/customers/dt=2026-10-01/customers.csv was never delivered. The orders, order_items and payments files for that day exist, match the contract, have no parse problems and have normal volumes (440 orders vs 412-534 over the prior 10 days). So the export ran, and only the customers file was dropped: a one-off delivery glitch. Per the runbook, redeliver the affected tables only (customers), then rerun the partition.
